web-guide-idea-59.audience: Adults seeking a thoughtful conversation with a knowledgeable religious teacher.
web-guide-idea-59.offer: Offer a focused discussion of a tradition, text or practice. Be clear about your background and avoid promises of cures, predictions or guaranteed outcomes.
web-guide-idea-59.steps.0: Ask which question or passage the guest wants to discuss.
web-guide-idea-59.steps.1: Explain context and invite their interpretation.
web-guide-idea-59.steps.2: Summarise the discussion and suggest a reading or reflection.
web-guide-idea-59.equipment: A phone, quiet room and the relevant text if needed.
web-guide-idea-59.returnReason: A series can explore related passages or questions with increasing depth.
web-guide-idea-59.promotion: Introduce your actual tradition and experience, with a sample of the topics you discuss.
